summary: The prepared base reproduced the reported contract violation: an SWA branch at depth 96 reduced the insertion key paired with a Mamba checkpoint from depth 192 to 96. At the exact candidate commit, the same real unified-cache regression passed and verified that depth 96 has no Mamba checkpoint, depth 192 owns the new checkpoint, the existing depth-64 and depth-128 checkpoints remain intact, and eviction of depth 192 falls back to depth 64. The candidate changes shared Python insertion preparation only and correctly prevents SWA from independently truncating a Full/SWA/Mamba insertion. This is a verified shared-logic fix, but full original-deployment resolution remains unverified because Rust TreeCore could not load without a runnable cargo and the H200 Inkling end-to-end workload was unavailable.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction on the actual prepared base implementation: effective insertion length was 96 instead of the unsliceable Mamba checkpoint depth 192. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/base/regression.log

Passing-after candidate behavior and an independent neighboring non-Mamba contract: hybrid checkpoint ownership remained correct while ordinary Full+SWA still capped insertion at its branch. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/candidate/focused-python.log

Broader adversarial hybrid-cache class: 131 tests ran, 39 passed and 92 configuration-gated tests skipped; no executable Python TreeCore counterexample was found. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/candidate/full-hybrid-class.log

Environment blocker, not a candidate failure: Rust TreeCore did not load because the extension loader could not execute cargo and raised PermissionError before the test body. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/candidate/rust-regression.log

gpu_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X was visible through HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0; torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015, gfx capability (9, 5), and a device tensor sum of 28.0 were recorded in /job/review-evidence/base/gpu-probe.log. The cache regression itself executed with that same GPU assignment.
remaining_limitations: The original observed configuration used H200, Rust TreeCore, Triton, and the real thinkingmachines/Inkling checkpoint. This prepared host provides one AMD Instinct MI350X with ROCm 7.2 instead.
Rust TreeCore validation is environment-blocked: cargo is not runnable/available from the prepared PATH, so the loader raises PermissionError while querying cargo before executing the regression.

The real Inkling checkpoint and original prompts were not present, so cold/warm logprob and greedy-token parity were not rerun. The review instead validated actual unified-cache node depths and Mamba slot ownership on GPU.

No native or FlyDSL C++ source changed in candidate commit 4920768354a34e14f43fb6d0c56ab491d608fa96, repository-environment.json declares no native artifact, and therefore no native rebuild was applicable.
HiCache-specific methods in the broad class were configuration-gated and skipped; the source issue explicitly does not require HiCache, so they were not treated as proof or as a counterexample.
